summary: CCC-era 1939 steel tower; top section and cab went to Hocking College; Forest Service rebuilt it at Wayne NF headquarters in 2007 and it now stores radio gear.

facts.design: 100-foot steel tower with a 7-by-7-foot cab (register); the top 20 feet and cab were the part moved to Hocking College
facts.status_note: The original ridgetop tower is gone; the tower was rebuilt at Wayne National Forest headquarters, where it stands.

staffing.status: no longer used as a lookout

access.note: Forest Service photo caption says it is not open to the public; a third-party guide says open for limited public use. Neither is dated.

visit.trail_note: Stands on the grounds of the Wayne National Forest headquarters on US 33; no source says whether the tower itself may be entered.

FFLA Ohio chapter report: relocated and opened next to the headquarters, and certified by the association

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Eastern lookouts, the state marker and the Forest Service photo all give 1939; the register's 1930s is consistent with that.
The register and the Forest Service photo both date the reacquisition and rebuild to 2007; 2010 is the FFLA report year.

notes_for_editor: Read: NHLR Snake Ridge page; Eastern lookouts Snake Ridge page (grep, 1939 line only); HMDB marker page; Natural Ohio Adventures page; Forest Service Flickr page; FFLA Ohio 2010 chapter report; FFLA Ohio list. Waymarking page returned only its title. Open conflicts, not resolved by the sources: (1) county of the original site, Athens (marker) vs Hocking (Eastern page, FFLA list); (2) dismantling date, 1964 (register) vs the 1970s (Natural Ohio, Flickr); (3) public access, 'not open to the public' (Forest Service Flickr, undated) vs 'open for limited public use' (Natural Ohio, undated); (4) the marker's footer says 'Erected 2005' while its text says the tower was reconstructed on the site, and the Forest Service dates the rebuild to 2007. The 1939 build year is consistent across sources. Height 100 ft is from the register and the Eastern page; no source gives a current height check. No staffing or fire history beyond 'actively used until the 1970s'. Photos not recorded: no image URL with a known license.
